quickPurchase.agreeTermsText: I agree to sign the Ngoc Linh Ginseng Care Authorization Contract and accept service regulations.
quickPurchase.careTermsItem1: • Ginseng seedlings are planted & cared for according to organic ecological standards at Tra Linh Ginseng Garden.
quickPurchase.careTermsItem2: • Technical team updates growth logs, height, foliage & real photos every 15 days.
quickPurchase.careTermsItem3: • Owner has the right to harvest real ginseng roots or convert into finished ginseng liquor at maturity.
